**Build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, one after the other.

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The new bundler sends `retryCount`. It now takes either one.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw when the flag was unset. Unset now means off, like before.

The 8 warnings name files that do not exist here. `build.js` just prints them.
